header: Monitoring data in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Proactively monitor your data in Amazon OpenSearch Service with alerting and anomaly detection.
Set up alerts to receive notiﬁcations when your data exceeds certain thresholds. Anomaly detection
uses machine learning to automatically detect any outliers in your streaming data. You can pair
anomaly detection with alerting to ensure you're notiﬁed as soon as an anomaly is detected.
